issues.description: In problem_statement.md Part 1, the attribute list names the student counts as `inscribedStudents` and `guestStudents`, but the UML diagram and the reference solution use `numberOfInscribedStudents` and `numberOfGuestStudents`. If tests follow the UML/solution, students who implement the names from the text will fail tests or be unsure which names are required.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the Part 1 attribute list in problem_statement.md to match the UML/solution names: `lectureName`, `numberOfInscribedStudents`, `numberOfGuestStudents`, `numberOfLecturers`, `numberOfTutors`.
